ck: (01) karnanirnaya:-tatrEka ahurakunan prahneti na tatyuktan srutiyuktivirotat tika-etatsanartayitun nayavatinan vipratipatin tavatutpavayati-tatreti tatravasare etatuktan pavati prahna tavanirkunan “kevalo nirkunasca" ityatisrute sakunatvasatakaprananapavaca tasya casesakunapurtipratyasa calapyavaharasanartasya nunursosaskulipaksanapratyasayita tata ca katanasitayasesakunapurtya prahnano nahatvasatanan kintu sarvatnakatveneti prativitate-neti yuktasaptasopanaparyaya yataha piksu tata ca yuktivirotana yuktaniti na satyavisistata yuktyupetaniti vyakyananasat prananatinatvatpraneyasite prananikaniti vaktavyatvat laksanaya prayocanapavat praticnatyaharaprasankaca srutiyukti-virotatiti tatra hetun vatata prahnanasakunatvesesakunapurnatve ca prananasatpavopi sucita yatyapyatra nahatan pratyaksanapi krahitun sakyate tatapi tatsatpavasrutyatinEva sataniya iti kOravanopatan na tvapavat utaratra krahanaca karnavicaya atra yuktyupetaniti yatyuktasaptasya vyakyanan tasya sanartanaya kecitevan vyakyanti …. yuktyupetanityasya vinarsa: yuktyupetasca vinarsa ityarta evanutaratra putipurvanityasya vinarsa:, putipurvakaca vinarsa iti, nukyavrtervinarsa: nukyavrtya ca vinarso na tupacarata ityartatvayan potyan 2 pa. ko. kan. can. 73,74 ….
s: (०१) कर्मनिर्णय:-तत्रैक आहुरगुणं ब्रह्मेति न तद्युक्तं श्रुतियुक्तिविरोधात् टीका-एतत्समर्थयितुं मायावादिनां विप्रतिपत्तिं तावदुद्भावयति-तत्र
